note: Fixture data for the agent portal (Module: finance-billing §16-21 agent dashboard + commission engine; crm-cases lead/customer; commerce-catalog §33 pipeline; facilities-scheduling §35 appointments).

Cross-references: customers 101-104 and lots D01-D03 exist in lib/fixtures/crm/customers.json and lib/fixtures/property/lots.json; every other record is UI demo data shaped for the approved agent-portal design (docs/08-delivery/agent-portal-design).

COMMISSION IS UNCONFIGURED BY DESIGN: every commission/target amount is null and `configured` is false — the client has not fixed rates (docs/07-client-villa/open-questions.md:26). Never fill these with invented figures.
Money is integer minor units (`*_cents`) only; views format through lib/money.ts and never parse display strings.
`possible_value_cents` is the full contract value (the 2026 sheet's monthly figure × the term), never a monthly quote — a monthly amount entered as cents reads 100× too small.

`first_contact_at` and `stage_history` are each lead's recorded movement: the first stage is `new` at `first_contact_at`, the last move is where the lead stands and lands on `last_contact_at`, and the dates line up with `prospect_activity` where an entry records the same conversation.

Appointment `starts_at` values are true instants: rendering them through lib/agent/agent-view.ts manilaTime() must reproduce the fixture's own `time_label`; lead-record dates render through manilaDay() the same way.
`example_*` records exist so the review design stays legible; they are labelled as examples in the UI and are not a live record.
